evidence: Semantic row 7 passes: the smallest submission satisfying instruction.md:1-7 needs a functioning multi-role offer desk plus saved, atomic two-to-four-offer compensation transfers, history-sensitive stale-preview refusal and idempotent receipt replay after later changes/restart. The detailed public obligations in environment/instructions/hireops_rules.md:424-479 require net budget validation, immutable intent, durable preview, all-or-none settlement and concurrent retry behavior; a static page or ordinary single-entity CRUD screen does not satisfy them. environment/Dockerfile:14-23 stages instructions/assets and initializes an empty /app, so a trivial tweak to a shipped finished app is not the build. Gates require genuine wrong-password/correct-password behavior (tests/gates/render/judge.toml:23) and creation of both a requisition and an associated PENDING offer followed by exact independent-context retrieval (constraints/judge.toml:23-25). The frozen template scoring shares/floor are retained. Functional criteria explicitly own complete-set netting (judge.toml:938), history-sensitive ABA rejection (1055), concurrent retry/overlap behavior (1082,1091), and original-receipt replay after later changes/restart (1145,1154). The reference contains actual SQLite intent storage, movement-based versions, net-delta calculation, transactional preview/commit and cached receipt return (solution/app/src/change-sets.js:8-15,38-64,77-104). Broken-app attempt: a polished static seed/mock or browser-local save cannot satisfy the independent-context creation gate; a balance-only freshness shortcut remains a substantive broken implementation and is specifically exposed by the ABA criterion. Conforming-alternative attempt: an initially empty operational roster with generated identities, different ordinary layouts/routes, and correct behavior is expressly allowed by instruction.md:11, constraints/judge.toml:23-25, and functional/prompt.md:13,23; it is not excluded as a stub. Raw local evidence corroborates selected distinctions: batch-witnesses/results.json records golden and empty_operational_seed exit 0 with 15 passing groups; balance_only_version fails the ABA 409 expectation, no_cached_receipt fails the concurrent retry 200 expectation, and sequential_budget refuses the funded cycle. I inspected the mutation driver (batch-witnesses.cjs:9-22) and underlying assertions (batch-domain.cjs:35-44,60-64,83-88). These are finite HTTP product checks, not configured judge scores. SHA256 verification read all 239 raw-index entries and found zero mismatches; index SHA256 81d7e30b67ececf39d5d2351a9f41140a8e5e401174e6a80efe9b9d7503791f1, batch-witnesses/results.json SHA256 477ba650c81ce00e5d6346f679b774f23c5a197b78b346bb183e7eb0a70bcf83, targeted-golden/results.json SHA256 016ecfc3ec82e063f4028f4466438fcc7b80d91f48b26b1787c5231bf5ce13c5; all targeted-golden source bindings match the frozen solution.
